about: Fume cupboard modelled as a generic product: base solvent store with two doors and label, epoxy work surface with spill lip and aerofoil sill, side posts with service taps and socket plate, back baffle, glazed counter-balanced sash with handle, upper glazing, canopy fascia with airflow monitor, alarm LED and light switch, galvanised extract spigot. Each type has its own geometry (parts carry 'only' for their type); shared parts have none.
